title: An Email to My Friend
text:
Hi Anna, thanks for your email! I was happy to hear from you. I am sorry I did not answer before. I was busy with my new job. How are you and your family?

This weekend I want to visit you. Can we meet on Saturday at two o'clock? We can have lunch at my favorite café. Please write back soon.

questions.text: Why did Maria not answer the email before?
options: She was busy with a new job.
She did not have the email.

questions.text: Where do they want to have lunch?
How does Maria feel about Anna?
options: She is friendly and likes Anna.
She does not know Anna well.
She wants to move away from Anna.

questions.text: Why does Maria want to visit Anna?
options: She wants to see her friend in person.
She wants to sell her car.
She wants to start a new job.

vocabulary.definition: a message sent by computer or phone
having a lot to do and not free
the one you like the most

paragraph_translations: Oi, Anna, obrigada pelo seu e-mail! Fiquei feliz em ter notícias suas. Sinto muito por não ter respondido antes. Eu estava ocupada com meu novo emprego. Como você e sua família estão?
Neste fim de semana eu quero visitar você. Podemos nos encontrar no sábado às duas horas? Podemos almoçar no meu café favorito. Por favor, responda logo.
